chasqui2026.description:
This December 20, run or walk for your roots at the Chasqui Migrante 5K & 10K. Join us in celebrating our identity, our families, and the pride of carrying our homeland in our hearts.

Registration includes an event shirt, timing chip, hydration, medal, race bib, certificate, fruit, and eligibility for various prizes.

Registration fee: $15 USD.

Organized by Fundación Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional.
